summary: This tutorial covers how to use snippets in the Gedit text editor on Ubuntu Linux 14.04. Snippets are pre-written lines of code that help reduce repetitive typing. To enable snippets in Gedit, you need to install the Snippets plugin from the Edit > Preferences menu under the Plugin System tab. After enabling snippets, typing "if" followed by Tab will automatically complete the if statement. The Intelligent Text Completion plugin also provides auto-closing brackets and quotes. You can manage your snippets by selecting Tools > Manage Snippets, where you can view, edit, or create new snippets. For example, creating a "helloWorld" snippet involves clicking the plus icon, typing "helloworld," and then editing the panel with a simple C code. Snippets significantly reduce redundancy in coding, making the development process more efficient.
